dek: X Square Robot has open-sourced HOST, an inference-time learning framework that lets a humanoid robot watch a 29-second human demonstration and reproduce the skill at 62 percent success. The approach flips the embodied-AI recipe from offline fine-tuning to on-the-fly imitation.
